To Whom It May Concern, My name is Grace Okafor and I am writing to provide a statement about an incident that occurred on 12/15/2025. I was driving my 2023 Chevrolet Equinox LT, dark blue, on County Route 18 near Mill Lane at around 6:51 in the morning. A deer suddenly entered the roadway from the right side before I could react, and I made contact with the front of the vehicle. The impact caused damage to the front grille, front bumper, hood edge and right headlamp. After the accident, I was unable to continue driving safely, so I called for a tow. The vehicle was towed from the scene. No one was injured in the incident. There were no other vehicles involved. I am providing this statement for the record and to support my claim.
